exec: (function(){var T=window.THREE,S=window.__app.scene;var o=[];var cam=new T.Vector3(-88.5,5.6,-6);for(var z=-30;z<=40;z+=3){var r=new T.Raycaster(cam,new T.Vector3(-4.5,-1.5,z).normalize());var h=r.intersectObjects(S.children,true).filter(function(v){return v.object.name.indexOf('main')===0});var t=[];for(var i=0;i<Math.min(2,h.length);i++)t.push(h[i].object.name.replace('main:','')+'@'+h[i].distance.toFixed(1));o.push('z'+z+':'+t.join(','));}return o.join(' ')})()
